notes: LIVE free-model directory for real deployment (node main.ts --providers providers.real.json).

Source: OpenRouter's public models API via https://byoklist.com/guides/openrouter-free-models (14 :free models, refreshed 2026-11-14), Groq's free plan and Google's Gemini free tier via https://www.freellm.site/blog/best-free-llm-apis-2026/ and https://gravity.fast/data/free-llm-api-tiers/.
The list changes often: free models come and go, usually previews that later become paid. Re-check the sources when a model stops working.
Ratings are indicative only (the trial's sealed ratings do not exist for real models); the router ranks by them and fails over when a model refuses, so a wrong rating costs a retry, not a request.
Capabilities (tools/vision/json) are as the provider exposes them; the router fails over when a model refuses a request it cannot serve.
Keys are BYOK: set OPENROUTER_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY in the environment. No key is stored in this repo and nothing is ever bought.
OpenRouter free limits: 20 req/min, 50 req/day with no credits bought, 1,000 req/day after $10 of credits bought (this entry never buys credits; 50/day is the free lane).
Groq free plan: 1,000 req/day per model, 200K tokens/day (gpt-oss-120b at 30 RPM). Gemini free tier: no card required.
Deliberately NOT in this directory: GitHub Models (retired July 2026), Cerebras and SambaNova (now need cards).
This file is for real use. The trial's simulated directory is the brief's ten providers (cerebras and sambanova included) and is graded against the brief, not this file.
